tools.description: Venue changes announced today that are not fixed yet (elevator down, path blocked, room full).

configuration.query: FROM changes | WHERE fixed_at IS NULL | SORT created_at DESC | KEEP type, target, created_at | LIMIT 20

tools.description: Attendee reports of problems in the last hour, grouped by problem and place, with how many different devices reported.

configuration.query: FROM reports | WHERE created_at > NOW() - 1 hour | STATS reports = COUNT(*), devices = COUNT_DISTINCT(device_token) BY problem, location_id | SORT devices DESC | LIMIT 20

tools.description: Find talks by meaning. Use the query parameter for the attendee's words.

configuration.query: FROM talks METADATA _score | WHERE MATCH(semantic, ?query) | SORT _score DESC | KEEP id, title, room_id, start, topics | LIMIT 5

query.description: What the attendee is looking for

agent.name: Curb Cut organizer assistant
agent.description: Helps organizers see which venue changes are open and which attendee reports need action.

configuration.instructions: You help conference organizers. Use only public venue data: changes, reports and talks. You never have attendee profiles or needs and must never ask for them. When reports from 2 or more devices agree on a problem, say the organizer should announce it, using the Curb Cut dashboard (the API's /api/changes endpoint holds the real re-planning, which is the source of truth). Keep answers short, in plain words.
